about: Questions employers commonly ask on application forms, asked once during onboarding and reused word-for-word. Answers stay on this computer. Agents never guess an answer: if a form asks something not answered here, they stop and ask. Questions marked voluntary default to 'Prefer not to say'.

questions.question: Are you legally entitled to work in Canada?
What is your status in Canada?
If you hold a permit, when does it expire? (YYYY-MM)
Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment authorization?
Other countries where you are authorized to work (if any)
Are you at least 18 years old (or the age of majority in your province)?
Are you willing to undergo a background check (criminal record, references, education and employment verification) if you receive an offer?
Have you been convicted of a criminal offence for which a record suspension (pardon) has not been granted?
options: Prefer to discuss with the employer
questions.note: Answer only as the form asks; if a form asks something broader, the agent stops and asks you.

questions.question: Are you willing to complete a vulnerable sector check if the role requires it?
Do you hold a Government of Canada security clearance? Which level and expiry?
Do you hold a valid driver's licence? (class and province)
Are you bound by a non-compete or non-solicitation agreement?
Are you willing to relocate? Where?
Which work arrangements are you open to?
How much travel are you willing to do?
How much notice do you need before starting? / Earliest start date
Which employment types are you open to?
options: Fixed-term with a clear step up

questions.question: Are you able to work evenings, weekends or shifts if required?
What are your salary expectations? (range and currency; the agent will use 'negotiable' when a form allows it, unless you say otherwise)
Should the agent ever disclose your current or past pay? (several provinces restrict asking)
options: No — leave blank or say 'prefer not to say'
Yes — use the figure I give

questions.question: Languages and level (e.g. English — fluent; French — intermediate)
Highest completed education (degree, field, institution, year)
If your education is from outside Canada, do you have a credential assessment (e.g. WES)?
Professional licences or designations (body, number if you want it shared, expiry)
References available on request, or list names, relationship and contact (only shared when a form asks)
Default answer when asked if you have previously worked for the employer (the agent checks your career library per employer)
Default answer when asked if you have relatives working at the employer
Default answer for 'How did you hear about this job?'
options: Referral — ask me for the name

questions.question: Do you want to request accommodation during the hiring process? (you can answer 'not at this time')
Gender (voluntary)
Do you identify as an Indigenous person? (voluntary)
Do you identify as a member of a visible minority / racialized group? (voluntary)
Do you identify as a person with a disability? (voluntary)
Do you identify as 2SLGBTQI+? (voluntary)
Are you a veteran? (voluntary)
